confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Andalusian city pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, café and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation, cocktail and July peak-season hotel rates are less certain. The FX observation comes from RBA overview and homepage search snippets for 15 October 2026 at 4pm, not from a full F11.1 table read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Seville, Granada and Málaga, with Córdoba priced somewhat below Seville and Málaga for restaurants and hotels. Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Spanish tourist cities in summer.
